Useful energy is obtained from different energy resources.
Four examples of energy resources are listed.
●
water waves
●
geothermal
●
wind
●
water behind hydroelectric dams
How many of these energy resources depend on radiation from the Sun?
A
1
B
2
C
3
D
4
